result.instructions: Tools for UseResponse, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which help desk tickets are still open, and who is responsible for each?"; "Show the latest comments on the ticket about the login bug."; "Find the users who wrote in this month, sorted by name.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes UseResponse data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run useresponse_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run useresponse_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run useresponse_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. useresponse_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: useresponse_create_object
tools.title: Create a ticket or topic
tools.description: Create a new ticket or topic (no attachments). Visible to customers once created. UseResponse API: POST /objects.json.

object_type.description: The type of the new object.

content.description: The body. BBcode is supported, HTML is not (at most 12000 characters).

tools.name: useresponse_create_comment
tools.title: Add a comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a ticket or topic. A private note is visible to staff only. Visible to customers unless is_private is 1. UseResponse API: POST /comments.json.

object_id.description: The ticket or topic id to comment on.

content.description: The comment body. BBcode is supported, HTML is not (at most 12000 characters).

reply_to.description: Id of the comment to reply to.

is_private.description: 1 saves a private staff note. Needs agent or admin rights.
